featured_reviews.name: DEVANSHI SAVLA
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best studio experiences I’ve had. Excellent lighting, spotless studio environment, and thoughtfully curated backdrops and props. featured_reviews.name: Maseera Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Supreme Studios is a brand-new, fully equipped studio designed to meet all your creative needs. It operates 24×7 and is managed by a highly supportive team that ensures a smooth working experience. The studio is loaded with all essential, high-quality equipment for professional use.
Located in Byculla, it stands out in an area where quality studios are hard to find.

featured_reviews.name: Foram Rambhia
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is very asthetic.  Each corner has a different vibe (setup) . We could use different corners for different shoots. I really enjoyed working with Umang Soni. He is very professional & quick & his work.  I would recommend people to work with me & even rent out his studio.

featured_reviews.name: DD
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Supreme Studios, Byculla!
The studio design is top-notch, clean, well-balanced, and clearly handled by people who know their craft. Perfect for podcast, product shoots, fashion shoots and even YouTube talking head videos. The equipment availability is excellent, with everything you need readily accessible and well-maintained, which makes the workflow super smooth.
A big shoutout to the staff very helpful, and genuinely supportive throughout the session. They make you feel comfortable and taken care of without being intrusive. And the 24-hour usage is a massive plus, especially for creators working with tight deadlines or odd-hour schedules.
Overall, Supreme Studios is a solid, reliable space for serious work. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and convenience in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Chaiti Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: A wonderful, newly set-up studio with all the required equipment and lighting. We did a maternity shoot with Umang and his expertise helped us get amazing pictures, truly turning our concept into reality. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Flaymm
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at this photoshoot studio. The setup is damn good — they have a wide range of professional lights and top-notch equipment, which makes shooting super smooth and efficient. The overall setup is well thought out and perfect for creative work.

Special mention to the owner, Umang — extremely friendly, supportive, and always goes the extra mile to help out. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional and hassle-free studio experience.

featured_reviews.name: Ojas Gosar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at Supreme Studio. I recently did a photoshoot here and everything—from the setup to the lighting to the overall vibe—was spot on. The space is super clean, thoughtfully designed, and really versatile depending on the kind of shoot you’re going for.

What really stands out is how comfortable and easy the whole experience felt. You don’t feel rushed, and there’s great attention to detail, which makes a huge difference when you’re in front of the camera.

Highly recommend Supreme Studio for anyone looking for a professional yet relaxed environment for photoshoots. Will definitely be coming back

I’m from Mumbai, and I recently got one of our old family VCR cassettes converted into a digital format by you. The cassette was from 1996 and captured my parents’ wedding something we hadn’t been able to watch properly for years.
Seeing those moments again with my family was truly emotional. It felt like going back in time and experiencing such an important day all over again. Everyone at home was so happy and touched watching it together.
The quality of the conversion was excellent and it’s clear that you handled the tape with great care. Thank you for helping us preserve such a priceless memory, we genuinely appreciate your work!

featured_reviews.name: Anusha Sundaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was the worst visa photograph I have ever gotten. I came to this studio because my usual studio is closed on Mondays. The owner insisted that I don't go for an immediate processing and come back later for a pick up to ensure high quality. I was fine with that. I went the next day to pick up the visa photos and it was terrible. Even though I mentioned many times that I had an appointment on the day of pick-up, the photos were not ready - they were still cutting the photos to proportion. The cutter used was so rusty that all the lines were jagged. The photo was terrible - there were vertical lines running down the photo.
I had no time to go to another studio to correct this. Unsurprisingly, the photo was rejected during visa processing and I had to take another photo at a premium price.
Obviously, this is the first and last time I visit this studio.
